segments.text: V. 30. The particular Providence of GOD is another Reaſon for your not fearing Man▪ For this extends to the very ſmalleſt Things. And i•••lle had ſuch Care over the moſt inconſiderable Creatures, how much more will he take Care of you (provided you confeſs Him before M•n, before powerful Enemies of the Truth) and that not only in this Life, but in the other alſo?
